name: Data.iotaAtLevel_injective
summary: By the norm formula the kernel is in the kernel of the weighted chain, which is injective in the triangle.

steps.claim: If iotaAtLevel(D, ϑ)(y) = 0, then by `Data.inner_iotaAtLevel` (with x = y) the weighted chain at y has norm 0, so it vanishes; the weighted chain of the triangle of `Data.exists_isTriangle` (for z = false) is injective on the base (`IsTriangle.eq_zero_of_weightedChain`, with 0 + m ≤ m), so y = 0.
steps.lean:
@[simp] lemma iotaAtLevel_injective : Function.Injective (D.iotaAtLevel ϑ) := .of_ker _ fun y e ↦
  (D.exists_isTriangle _).choose_spec.eq_zero_of_weightedChain D.m 0 (by simp) _
  (by simpa [e, -Fintype.card_pi] using! D.inner_iotaAtLevel ϑ y y)
